title: The Meaning of Rochdale: The Rochdale Pioneers and the Co-operative Principles
lineage: Inspected the stated text; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: Pages 9–10 distinguish the 1845 one-member-one-vote rule and 1854 provision for an education fund of 2.5 percent of surplus before distribution, intended for members and families. It describes statutes, not actual payment or attendance.
